name: Crystal Quest: Arcane Tower
review:
Part of the Crystal Quest trilogy, on six reels with 4,096 ways. Avalanches, infinite multipliers and a linked reels feature drive it.

The linked reels are what set this one apart from its two siblings: matching reels make big ways wins much more likely, and every avalanche pushes the uncapped multiplier further. High volatility, 15,000x cap, 96.17% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
